ValidationRule.description: Blocks advancing StageName past Explore while a linked Test Drive lacks a Result (AF_TestDriveGateBlocked__c, flow-maintained). ISCHANGED(StageName) scoping stops the background sync flow's own updates from tripping this rule.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( AF_TestDriveGateBlocked__c, ISCHANGED(StageName), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Select"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Commit"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Take the Keys"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Opportunity has a Test Drive without a recorded Result. Record Completed or Refused (with remarks) before progressing past Explore.
